scope: Independently authored process-identity observer for the repository's effect-free MCP relay
constraints: Standard library only; no previous implementation or upstream fixture input
Records only its own PID and current process group before exec of the adjacent owned-relay binary
At most 32 records and 1024 file bytes, mode 0600, no symlink following, nonblocking exclusive lock
Forwards existing descriptors and arguments without parsing or recording MCP frames, prompts, credentials or tool output
Accepts only the relay --config entry or the independent --version identity control
The ordinary observed-relay and all --version controls preserve process groups
Only the explicitly named joining-relay experiment attempts to join its parent's group before relay exec and writes one fixed outcome marker to an exclusive private file
Parent identity is an experimental assumption, not a production group authorization mechanism; no effective execution restriction is asserted
